scope: NBHL ball hockey only; no new task training on other sports
profile_definition: Defaults with actual 15 fps; sports tutorial uses minimum_consecutive_frames=3. long_buffer changes only lost_track_buffer to 120 (four seconds at any fps). Scene cuts reset IDs with a unique scene prefix. Unassigned -1 outputs are excluded. Only current detection boxes are emitted.
selection: For each detector, maximize summed development correct - 10*wrong, then more matched observations, fewer uncertain joins, fewer fragments, then default profile and lexical method ID. Freeze before scoring regression. Always retain the tutorial ByteTrack comparator and the existing pipeline.

team.fit: Per recording, deterministic uniform sampling of up to 512 automatic player crops at frames 7+15k with confidence>=0.65. No reference identities, team names or labels enter fit.
team.implementation: Use sports.TeamClassifier with its original SigLIP features, UMAP 3D and two-cluster KMeans; fix random seeds and n_init=10 for reproducibility.
team.evaluation: Classify automatic detections on frozen reference timestamps, match one-to-one IoU>=0.5 and align the two cluster names only for scoring. Report all assignments and a predeclared distance-margin>=0.2 plus training 95th-percentile distance gate. The gate may abstain.
team.limits: Unsupervised per-recording adaptation; evaluation footage contributes unlabeled fitting samples. Team membership is not player identity.

geometry: Run sports.ViewTransformer on the existing New Jersey relative-coordinate correspondences; check numerical equivalence on real saved points. This is software replacement verification, not new calibration accuracy. Dimensions remain unverified and metric distances disabled.
ball: Run sports.BallTracker on existing ball-only detector candidates where available, retaining unknown visibility and resetting between independent windows. Report conditional reviewed-visible localization separately from unsupported full-game event claims.
jersey: Inspect and exercise the tutorial's repeated-reading consensus using archived per-image number predictions. This does not replace a trained number-region detector or establish a ball-hockey OCR model.
reference_policy: Preserve all frozen references; reused sparse assistant-reviewed regression, no independent human ground truth, HOTA/IDF1, full-game identity, TOI or miles claim.
